wholeSemanticReview: For N<256, cell_memberships adds nothing and build_cells delegates to the entire byte-exact contiguous constructor. Its original source-order return and prices remain after the new inactive mode-dispatch check. No withdrawn prototype ordering is silently enabled for small inputs.

For larger inputs, every original facet bound remains at its original ordinal. The exact world union contains every lower/upper coordinate. For nonzero width, lower+upper-2*worldLower lies in[0,2*width], hence exact scaled center4*relative/width lies in[0,8]. Nonnegative integer truncation is floor, clamp7 handles the endpoint and zero extent maps to0 without division. Three 3-bit digits interleave to a key in[0,511]. These rational calculations affect grouping only, never source geometry or query acceptance.

Counting each input once, initialized512bins, exclusive prefix offsets and source-order stable scatter fill exactly N distinct positions with each ordinal[0,N) once. The extra order[N]=N mode marker is outside every recursive node range; all traversals access source_ordinal only at positions start<=p<end<=N. LengthN+1 dispatch distinguishes the cell mode from None/lengthN frozen prototype modes; it does not emit the marker as an ordinal.

Balanced count-median nodes partition the permutation without gaps/duplicates. Leaf bounds union the actual original facet boxes; parent bounds union actual child bounds. Leaf owner proof compares every mapped original owner; internal Some owner requires equal child Some values. A mixed range cannot be treated as uniform. Physical-box, outward-plane, ray-slab and owner tests are unchanged necessary conditions, so regrouping cannot discard a valid facet. Poor grouping can only increase candidate visits.

Fresh per-query bitset first checks every candidate ordinal range and duplicate before indexing/insertion. Prefix population counts give each unique selected ordinal a distinct ascending rank in[0,K). In-place cycle swaps move the COMPLETE Copy record, including all physical/outward flags and payload fields, to its fixed rank. Every swap fixes its target; it cannot displace a previously fixed distinct record, so at most K-1 swaps terminate the process. The remaining positions are already fixed. Empty vectors return unchanged and singleton keys are still range-checked. No parity/occupancy/intersection value is recomputed, merged, cached or carried across queries.

All source_order production callers use pure actual ordinal keys and reserve returned records through ordering. Original physical/joint/ray traversal leaves partition the input, producing at most one record per ordinal. Restored ascending original-vector order preserves ordered section/coplanar records, ray ambiguity order, owner multiplicity and downstream fields. Generic ray generation, section geometry, clipping, contacts/protected sets, affine fields, stars, witnesses, topology and final volume remain unchanged.

Work accounting retains all performed original box/node/query/predicate prices. Added charges cover world clones/unions and extents, every facet/axis/nonzero conversion, all9bit copies per key, key/count/scatter transfers,512bin initialization/prefix visits,N+1order initialization and marker write; rank restoration charges both word initializations, three per checked insertion, every prefix word, rank lookup and two moved records per swap. The structural mode dispatch follows existing uncharged mode-choice conventions. No performed geometric operation is discounted.

Persistent cell reservation adds N+16 for orderN+1/header. N+512+48 construction scratch holds keysN,512cursors, world/extents/rational intermediates and headers while returned order is separately admitted. Node recursion retains the original independent stack bound. Query scratch2*ceil(N/64)+2*fields+16 holds freshly initialized bit/rank words and full swap payload; original caller admission still owns returned records. Scoped scratch releases after actual last use on success and every error; partial rank permutations are dropped on failure, never published. Constructor errors preserve caller-owned index/input reservation, matching the old constructor policy.

Current actual parent is CONTIGUOUS. Recursive sorting and payload-map work avoided by this design belong to a withdrawn test-only prototype, not costs removed from the current production baseline. Index+query tests compare against the real contiguous constructor and include added grouping/order work. No completed-original work reduction, speed, fit, minimum or admission is established by source review.

Four authored cases cover threshold255/256/257/512, exact full permutation, original-box containment/uniform-owner tags, every finite query and representative axis/oblique rays, complete ordered section/coplanar/parity outputs, full flag payload rank cycles across64-bit words, duplicate/range rejection, exact/one-short storage and Operations refusal, and zero extent/same-cell coverage. A complete264-facet22-separated-box publisher comparison checks every triangle with nonzero world-affine UV, all witnesses, retained accounting and independent analytic volume176. Full index-plus-query operations and paired monotonic10x ceilings are assertions, not current passes. Full publisher does not assume a performance win. All prior full-face/corner-negative controls and322/108/120 guards remain.
